purpose: Independent researcher-side ground truth for validating the replay harness battery. Measured by `researcher`, not by the harness under test.

eip7951_precompile.note: PR #509 quotes ~3500, a superseded draft constant. Measured and spec both 6900.

eip2929_access_asymmetry.finding: Precompile 0x100 is PRE-WARMED; ordinary contract addresses are NOT.
eip2929_access_asymmetry.consequence: delta_gas is NOT n13 * constant. The OLD path pays a one-off ~2,500 gas cold-access charge on the FIRST algorithm-13 dispatch of a transaction that the NEW path does not. Subsequent dispatches are warm on both sides.
eip2929_access_asymmetry.why: EIP-2929 cold/warm accounting has been live since Berlin (block 12,244,000, Apr 2021). The earliest transaction in this census is block 13,083,904 (Aug 2021). Every call in the population is post-Berlin, so this asymmetry existed on mainnet at execution time and is part of the true saving, not measurement error.
eip2929_access_asymmetry.effect_on_naive_estimator: n13 * delta_13 UNDER-estimates by ~2,500 gas per eligible transaction.
